messages:
ravi: FYI noticed some phantom credits in invoice-preview for customers behind the new sticky-router. Preview shows +tokens that never appear in final invoice. Can we triage? :grimacing:
zoe: I saw alerts from the preview-delta dashboard. Graph spikes align with sticky-router resyncs around the 10m mark. Could be late-acked events that preview consumes but aggregator discards.
nash: Repro: simulate sticky failover -> two routers accept same stream for ~3s -> preview consumer (reads pre-aggregator Kafka topic) ingests both, final aggregator dedupes by commit id. So preview overcounts.
billing-bot: billing-monitor: preview_delta>0 detected for tenants=[1201,1205,1988] peak=1420 tokens at 2026-03-17T10:12:00Z.
ravi: OK short-term: we should annotate preview rows with ingestion_stage (pre-agg/post-agg) and show a "stability" flag in UI to reduce support noise. Long-term we need to align dedupe logic.
zoe: Adding ingestion_stage is a small schema bump (meta.ingest_stage v1). Will default to pre-agg for current events. Also can emit preview_confidence metric: 0..1 by how close event is to commit watermark.
nash: Implementation note: preview consumer can apply a cheap in-memory dedupe window keyed by (request_id, fingerprint) with TTL 5s to reduce dupes from failover storms. That won't be perfect but should drop most noise.
ops-bot: router: sticky-resyncs=7 in last 15m, probable_cause=heartbeat-lag, affected_zones=[eu-central].
ravi: Metrics and alerts: threshold for auto-mitigate: preview_delta_rate > 0.005 for tenant over 10m OR preview_delta_tokens > 5000 across cluster. Who owns alert rule?
zoe: I'll own alert + dashboard card. Will add a per-tenant heatmap and book a Finance sync.
nash: Also want a traceability field so finance can map preview rows to final invoice rows: propose meta.preview_id stamped at ingress and copied to final invoice when committed. Auditing SQL will use that.
ravi: Sounds good. Let's keep preview latency <3s. If adding dedupe increases latency, we toggle by tenant via feature flag.
zoe: Quick SQL for audit mapping (to include in PR):
```sql
SELECT p.tenant_id, p.request_id, p.preview_id, i.invoice_id, i.tokens, i.committed_at
FROM preview_events p
LEFT JOIN invoice_rows i ON i.preview_id = p.preview_id OR i.request_id = p.request_id
WHERE p.tenant_id IN (1201,1205)
ORDER BY p.event_time DESC
```
ash: Risk: preview_id schema + preview_confidence metric must be backward compatible. We'll version meta.preview.v1. Also need e2e smoke test simulating router failover.
ravi: Timeline: zoe -> dashboard + alert in 1h; nash -> in-memory preview dedupe + PR by EOD; zoe+nash -> canary on 5 tenants in eu-central tonight; ops-> monitor and revert knob ready.
billing-bot: finance-notify: finance@redwood.ai added to canary alert channel.
zoe: I'll also add a small UI hint: "Preview may overcount during routing resyncs" and an expandable audit trail link for affected tenants.
ravi: Agreed. After canary, we'll evaluate whether to move dedupe into ingress (stronger but larger rollout risk) vs keep in preview consumer.
nash: I'll paste the draft PR with code for in-memory TTL deduper (Rust worker) in ~2h. It emits metric preview.dedupe_hits.
ops-bot: ticket-created: ENG-6123 'preview-phantom-credits-sticky-router' assigned=[nash, zoe], priority=high
zoe: tagging @support so CS knows how to explain to customers. Short message to customers: "Invoice preview is an estimate; final invoice is authoritative. We're rolling fixes to reduce overcounts during router handoffs."
ravi: Thanks everyone. Keep Finance and Support in loop, and record canary results in the ticket.
